# Shared database access

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/db)

Share PostgreSQL connection factories, existing Drizzle integration and raw-SQL compatibility helpers.

**Scope:** Connection and query plumbing; does not own every app schema or grant production database access.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/db`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. The shared factory and compatibility layer are present. Application migrations and business transactions remain with their owning app or domain.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Reuse existing helpers and app conventions; keep migrations append-only and verify transaction behavior with explicitly scoped fixtures.
